title: The board shows heads waiting in the merge queue as moving, with their place and the merge ahead
description: The command step seeds one submitted head whose merge trial is in flight and two healthy heads queued behind it; the board counts the queued heads as moving with their queue position and the in-flight item ahead, not Blocked or overdue, and the Work page names their place in the queue.

steps.name: seed a merge in flight and two heads queued behind it
the queued heads are moving with their queue position
the Work page names the queued head's place behind the merge in flight
